cases.title: Communication about life-sustaining therapy: insights from the Adaptive Leadership Framework
cases.design: Selected longitudinal clinical case; one mother/infant case from a larger 23-case study, with 23 mother/provider interviews over four phases.
cases.mechanism: Distinguishes technical treatment work from adaptive changes in expectations and relationships; provider expertise can displace family agency and avoid difficult conversations.
cases.limitations: Work avoidance is contrary evidence: describing adaptive qualities did not ensure that the social worker exercised them. A selected case cannot estimate treatment effects.
cases.read_scope: Targeted full-text methods, relevant results and limitations sections; not exhaustive line-by-line appraisal of every reference/table.

cases.title: Adaptive leadership in clinical encounters with women living with HIV
cases.design: Descriptive qualitative cross-sectional interviews with 22 women in North Carolina WIHS, July–October 2016.
cases.mechanism: Reciprocal care, communication, trust and patient self-advocacy connect provider support with patients' adaptive work.
cases.limitations: Participant accounts do not establish causal efficacy. No participant feedback/member checking; geographically bounded sample.
cases.read_scope: Targeted full-text methods, relevant results and limitations sections; not exhaustive line-by-line appraisal of every reference/table.

cases.title: Adaptive Challenges, Adaptive Work, and Adaptive Leadership Among Women Living With HIV in the Southern United States: Findings From a Qualitative Study
cases.design: Directed qualitative analysis of 22 interviews with women in North Carolina WIHS, July–October 2016.
cases.mechanism: Adaptive challenges require changes in values, attitudes, skills and behaviour alongside technical clinical care; patient-provider co-creation is emphasized.
cases.limitations: Same interview-study family as the companion HIV article is strongly supported. Do not count it as an independent replication.
cases.read_scope: Targeted full-text methods, relevant results and limitations sections; not exhaustive line-by-line appraisal of every reference/table.

cases.title: Adaptive leadership Competencies for hybrid work teams in the South African banking sector
cases.design: Qualitative purposive interviews with 20 managers across five South African banks; 80% top management.
cases.mechanism: Hybrid-work adaptation joins listening, feedback, trust and delegation with organizational support, ICT and performance-management changes.
cases.limitations: Managers' perceptions are not representative workforce estimates or a causal intervention evaluation.
cases.read_scope: Targeted full-text methods, relevant results and limitations sections; not exhaustive line-by-line appraisal of every reference/table.

cases.title: Advancing Adaptive Leadership Through Adaption‐Innovation Theory: Enhancements to The Holding Environment
cases.design: Conceptual integration of Adaption–Innovation theory with adaptive leadership.
cases.mechanism: Proposes that cognitive-style diversity shapes the holding environment and productive disequilibrium needed for social learning.
cases.limitations: Individual problem-solving style and group leadership process are different constructs. The proposed integration explicitly needs empirical exploration.
cases.read_scope: Targeted full-text methods, relevant results and limitations sections; not exhaustive line-by-line appraisal of every reference/table.

cases.title: Development and validation of the adaptive leadership behavior scale (ALBS)
cases.design: Three cross-sectional scale-validation studies: 201 followers, 311 followers and 155 leader-follower dyads.
cases.mechanism: Operationalizes leader flexibility through situational perception, behavioural repertoire, balancing demands and appropriate application. Four facets support a one-factor scale in these samples.
cases.limitations: Psychometric and correlational evidence is not causal validation of adaptive leadership. Overall perceived employee-effectiveness association was not significant; the time-together analysis was supplementary. Subjective ratings and culture/context limits remain.
cases.read_scope: Targeted full-text methods, relevant results and limitations sections; not exhaustive line-by-line appraisal of every reference/table.
